## Install

1. Download **lemontabs-VERSION.zip** below and unzip it into a folder that will stay put.
2. Open `chrome://extensions` and turn on **Developer mode** (top right).
3. Click **Load unpacked** and pick the unzipped folder.
4. Open a new tab. If Chrome asks whether to keep the changed new tab page, click **Keep it**.

Chrome allows one new-tab extension at a time, so turn off other new-tab extensions.

**Update:** unzip the new release over the same folder, then press ↻ on the lemontabs card in `chrome://extensions`.
